codeReview.summary: The fix correctly replaces the silent `let _ = self.uart.flush()` with explicit error handling. On flush failure, a 1ms safety delay is inserted before releasing the DE pin (ensuring the shift register has time to drain), then TransportError::Io is returned to the caller. The implementation is clean and well-commented.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Other locations in app/src/main.rs still use the `let _ = uart.flush()` silent-ignore pattern (lines 790, 811, 855, 861). These are outside this feature's scope but represent the same class of potential issue.

summary: PASS — All three validation assertions are satisfied. VAL-BH-007: `let _ = self.uart.flush()` is completely removed from transport.rs. VAL-BH-008: DE pin is only released after successful flush or a 1ms safety delay on failure. VAL-BH-009: Flush failure returns Err(TransportError::Io) to the caller. The fix is well-structured with clear comments explaining the safety-delay rationale. No blocking issues found.
